title: One-morphism restriction square for the sections comparison
statement: Let $a:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes. Let $C$ be any cochain complex of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$. Inverse image and its exact derived localization are as in [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], derived sections as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], and the derived adjunction unit as in [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction]. Put $F=a^{-1}$, $G=\Gamma_Y$, $H=\Gamma_X$, and let $r:G\to F H$ be the underived adjunction unit followed by the sections Leray isomorphism. Let $s_Z(B):Q\Gamma_Z B\to R\Gamma_Z(QB)$ be the right-derived sections unit transported through the homotopy quotient comparison. Let $\varphi_C:DF(QC)\cong Q(FC)$ be the exact-localization comparison. Then $s_Y(C)\mathbin{\gg}RG(\eta^D_{QC})\mathbin{\gg}\operatorname{Leray}_{DF(QC)}=Q(r_C)\mathbin{\gg}s_X(FC)\mathbin{\gg}RH(\varphi_C^{-1})$. No injectivity, boundedness, etaleness, or invertibility of either sections unit is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03Q9 (theorem-higher-direct-images), final injective-complex paragraph; naturality detail of its maps of sections complexes

proof.text: For F=a inverse image, R=a direct image, G=sections on Y and H=sections on X, use the unbounded derived adjunction factorization derivedη_fac_app on the homotopy class of C. Postcompose the desired square by RH of the hom exact-localization comparison for F. Naturality of the Leray isomorphism moves this comparison to RG of RR, where the adjunction factorization replaces the derived unit by Qh of the termwise adjunction unit followed by the R-derived unit.

Naturality of the G-derived unit on the termwise adjunction unit now gives Qh of G applied to that unit, followed by the G-derived unit and RG of the R-derived unit. The defining factorization of rightDerivedFunctorCompIso and rightDerivedFunctorNatIso for R then G isomorphic to H identifies this composite with Qh of the underived sections restriction followed by the H-derived unit. Cancel RH of the exact-localization comparison, an isomorphism.

Transport this homotopy-category equality to the image of C under Q using naturality of quotientCompQhIso and the formula mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app. The homotopy adjunction unit on the quotient of C is the quotient of its termwise unit, by mapHomotopyCategory_unit_app_quotient. Functoriality and the factorization isomorphisms identify the composite with the displayed chain-level restriction. Cancel only these isomorphisms; the sections-derived units need not be invertible. This proof applies to unbounded complexes, the zero complex, arbitrary nonetale morphisms and empty schemes.

theorem sectionsComparison_restriction_square {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (C : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) :
  let restriction :=
    Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).unit
          (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a)
          (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).hom
  let toDerived (Z : Scheme.{v})
      (B : CochainComplex (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) :=
    (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).inv.app
        (((Sheaf.Γ Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj B) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj B) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app B)
  toDerived Y C ≫
    (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).rightDerivedFunctor.map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).unit.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
      AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).hom.app
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex restriction (.up ℤ)).app C) ≫
      toDerived X
        (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C)
